turns.text: Don’t you have work to do?
It may not look it, Neil, but I’m actually as busy as a bee!
turns.zh: 尼尔，可能看着不像，但我其实忙得团团转！

turns.text: If you’ve seen nature documentaries about worker bees flying from flower to flower, you probably think animals are always on the move.
turns.zh: 如果你看过关于工蜂在花丛间飞来飞去的自然纪录片，你大概会觉得动物总是在不停地动。

turns.text: But the surprising truth is, away from the cameras, most animals spend most of the time doing absolutely nothing at all.
turns.zh: 但令人惊讶的事实是，在镜头之外，大多数动物大部分时间都什么都不做。

turns.text: In the natural world where finding food and shelter is hard work, why have some animals evolved to do nothing?
turns.zh: 在觅食和找栖身之处都很费劲的自然界里，为什么有些动物会进化成什么都不做呢？

turns.text: And if it’s good enough for animals, would being lazy work for humans too?
turns.zh: 而且如果这对动物有好处，那偷懒对人是不是也行得通呢？

turns.text: That’s what we will be discussing in this programme, and as usual, we’ll be learning some useful new vocabulary as well.
turns.zh: 这就是我们本期节目要讨论的内容，而且像往常一样，我们还会学一些有用的新词汇。
